metadata.title: Manufacturing Infrastructure | G.M. Consolidated
metadata.description: Three industrial units in Kala Amb, Himachal Pradesh supporting integrated appliance engineering, die casting, injection moulding, tooling, finishing, assembly and routine testing.

hero.title: From Material to Finished Product.
hero.description: Three industrial units in Kala Amb, Himachal Pradesh, supporting integrated appliance engineering, manufacturing, finishing, assembly and testing.
hero.imageAlt: Production floor of the G.M. Consolidated industrial units, Kala Amb

intro.title: Built Around Integrated Manufacturing.
intro.description: G.M. Consolidated operates across three specialized industrial units in Kala Amb, with capabilities spanning tooling, forming, moulding, component manufacturing, finishing, assembly and routine testing.

productionFlow.title: Nine Stages. One Finished Product.
productionFlow.description: From die casting and injection moulding to thermostat production and conveyorised assembly, every stage of the manufacturing sequence runs in-house across the three units.

steps.title: Pressure Die Casting
steps.description: 120–250 ton pressure die casting capability supporting component and soleplate manufacturing.

steps.title: Plastic Injection Moulding
steps.description: 25 injection moulding machines ranging from 80–400 ton, supporting engineering plastics and insert moulding.

steps.title: Press Shop
steps.description: Automatic sheet feeding and progressive tooling for formed components.

steps.title: Tool Room
steps.description: CNC vertical machining and EDM capability supporting in-house tooling requirements.

steps.title: PTFE Coating
steps.description: Specialized PTFE coating operations supporting appliance components.

steps.title: Thermostat Manufacturing
steps.description: Dedicated thermostat manufacturing capability with approximately 4 million annual capacity.

steps.title: Heating Elements
steps.description: In-house heating element manufacturing supporting appliance production.

steps.title: Conveyorised Assembly
steps.description: Auto-conveyorised assembly operations for finished appliance production.

steps.title: Routine Testing
steps.description: Finished products undergo routine testing before release.

coreCapabilities.title: Technical Capability Across the Manufacturing Flow.
coreCapabilities.description: A deeper look at the production technologies and materials handled across the three units.

integration.title: Engineering, Tooling and Production Working Together.
integration.description: The manufacturing ecosystem brings product development, tooling, component manufacturing, finishing, assembly and testing into a coordinated production flow.
integration.note: The strength is not individual machines — it is the integration of every manufacturing stage under one roof.

qualityBridge.title: Manufacturing Is Only Half the Process.
qualityBridge.text: Finished products move into inspection and routine testing — every unit is tested before release, not just sampled.

closing.title: Built to Support Your Appliance Programme.
closing.description: From tooling and component manufacturing to assembly and testing, our integrated capabilities support OEM, ODM, private-label and bulk manufacturing requirements.
